subject: craft
angle: The invitation mistakes we see most often
caption:
Most paper mistakes happen when couples pick textured dark stock without checking if phones can read the QR code.

· Dark ink on dark paper makes text impossible to read
· Paper lighter than two hundred gsm feels like bond paper
· QR codes shrink below two centimeters and stop working
· Glossy coats reflect venue lights and blur photos
